shape: 2-portal arena (N + S gates) with central super-hub + east column + west wall + south detour cluster
description: Two-portal arena. NORTH ENTRY HUB (fiizr7 at (-10.35, -16.70), 5-way) joins spawn_north plus 4 spread anchors. CENTER super-hub (tizlf2 at (-14.50, 3.99), 4-way) joins west wall + north-arc detour cluster (ry37j6 + osa223 + l96tum + t1mdid). SE COLUMN: south_inner (8x6jjl) → 46ot9b → 39uzld → howytl (east column dead-end pocket). SOUTH bridge (afn0i2 → t1mdid → center).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-10.83, -23.37) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.south: spawn_south at (16.02, 17.88) — gate on the south (high-Z) side

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → se_pocket → e_col_low → e_col_mid → south_inner → spawn_south. 6 hops via the east column.
Alt N→S via center: spawn_north → north_inner → south_w (or south_d, south_c) → center → n_arc → ... (no direct path to south_inner from center).
DISPATCH RULE: north_inner is the 5-way north dispatcher; center is the 4-way west-side dispatcher; se_pocket is a 2-way bridge between north_inner and east column.
n_pocket is a 1-degree dead-end off n_arc.
s_bridge (2331sp) is a 3-way detour anchor near center.
